title: Convert From JSON
description: Parse JSON text into lists, objects, scalars, booleans, or null values.

configuration_schema.description: Convert a JSON representation into an object.

output.description: Name of the output column. If omitted, the input column will be overwritten

default.description: Value to return if the row is empty or fails to be parsed as JSON. If input is a list, default may also be a list - either a single value to apply to all columns, or one value per input column.

parameters.description: Name of the output column. If omitted, the input column will be overwritten

parameters.description: Value to return if the row is empty or fails to be parsed as JSON. If input is a list, default may also be a list - either a single value to apply to all columns, or one value per input column.

schema.description: Value to return if the row is empty or fails to be parsed as JSON. If input is a list, default may also be a list - either a single value to apply to all columns, or one value per input column.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

examples.title: Parse JSON objects and lists
examples.recipe:
wrangles:
  - convert.from_json:
      input: attributes_json
      output: attributes

guidance:
Use `convert.from_json` when a column contains JSON text that later wrangles
need to treat as structured values.

## Behavior

- Each non-fallback value is parsed with Python's JSON parser.
- Omitting `output` overwrites the input column.
- Multiple input columns may share one fallback or use one fallback per input.
- Invalid JSON raises an error unless a non-null fallback is supplied.
- Permissive Python-literal or YAML-like parsing is outside this wrangle's
  contract.
